name: Observing
detailed_description:
Genre: Horror, Survival, Psychological Thriller

Short Description:
After a catastrophic meteor fall, Earth has become a deadly trap. The ozone layer is destroyed, and sunlight can boil blood within minutes. You have taken shelter in a house, struggling to survive, but people appear outside, pleading for help. The problem is that some of them are infected with parasites capable of controlling bodies. Your task is to make a decision: let the stranger in or keep them outside?

Key Features:

  • Intense Survival: Make tough moral choices — who can be trusted, and who should be feared?

  • Psychological Pressure: Every decision could be your last — the infected can pretend to be human.

  • Observation and Analysis: Use clues, rumors on the radio, and news hints to identify who is infected.

  • Atmosphere of Tension: As the line between reality and paranoia blurs, fear slowly seeps in.

  • Multiple Outcomes: Your choices shape the fate of both the survivors and yourself.

content_descriptors.notes:
What should customers know about any adult content in your game:
This game contains scenes of psychological tension, violence, and survival in a post-apocalyptic setting.
It includes the following elements:

Violence and death, including the killing of infected individuals

References to bodily infection and loss of mental control

Elements of fear, paranoia, and moral decision-making (e.g., deciding who to let into the shelter)

Possible mentions or depictions of suicide and despair

The game does not include sexual content or sexual violence.

Recommended for a mature audience (18+) due to dark atmosphere, psychological pressure, and survival themes under extreme stress.
